summary: The refit resolves Arc15’s inclusion in the published astrocyte diet comparison. Including Arc15 reproduces all 5,350 Figure 2g genes to a maximum absolute log2 fold-change difference of 1.08 × 10⁻¹⁰. Those genes cover 54.28% of the registered output, below the 90% requirement for full-table concordance. The proposal passed validation. No ledger was edited.
openIssues: Two published sources disagree on all 510 shared astrocyte effects for glucose versus saline on chow. Which mice, nuclei and edgeR fit produced the ARC/VMH column of Supplementary Figure 5a?
Sixteen of 28 registered population–contrast pairs lack a matching author coefficient. The proposal retains per-track measurements in evidence and requests no dataset-wide sign-off.
